parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const headers=$json.headers??{};const pack=body.delivery_pack||body.generated_output||{mode:'assembled_from_existing_outputs',note:'Delivery pack will be assembled from content_outputs in Postgres'};const packSql=JSON.stringify(pack).replace(/'/g,"''");return [{json:{...body,job_id:body.job_id||$json.job_id||"",agent_secret:headers["x-agent-secret"]||headers["X-Agent-Secret"]||"",pack_sql:packSql}}];

parameters.query: =WITH gate AS (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND approval_stage='final_delivery' AND decision='approved') AS allowed), output_summary AS (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type',output_type,'title',title,'qa_status',qa_status,'id',id)) AS outputs FROM content_outputs WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid), pack_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id,output_type,title,structured_data,qa_status) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'delivery_pack','Delivery Pack',jsonb_build_object('provided_pack','{{$json.pack_sql}}'::jsonb,'included_outputs',COALESCE((SELECT outputs FROM output_summary),'[]'::jsonb)),'passed' FROM gate WHERE allowed RETURNING id), job_update AS (UPDATE content_jobs SET status='delivery_ready',updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND (SELECT allowed FROM gate) RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'delivery_pack_ready','Delivery pack created and ready for human delivery',jsonb_build_object('allowed',(SELECT allowed FROM gate),'delivery_pack_id',(SELECT id FROM pack_insert)))) SELECT (SELECT allowed FROM gate) AS allowed, (SELECT id::text FROM pack_insert) AS delivery_pack_id;
